description: This file defines the HtaccessWriter class in Drupal, responsible for managing Apache .htaccess files, including creating and ensuring protected directories and handling security warnings.

classes.name: HtaccessWriter
classes.description: A class providing functions to manage Apache .htaccess files within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HtaccessWriter with logger, stream wrapper manager, and optional settings.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Ensures that necessary .htaccess files are created in protected directories and staging area if auto-creation is enabled.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a .htaccess file in the specified directory with security settings.

methods.name: defaultProtectedDirs
methods.description: Returns a list of default protected directories for Drupal files, including public, private, temporary, and assets directories.
